title: CombatDistanceHUD
description: A lightweight, fully customizable Fabric client-side HUD mod that displays real-time combat distance information directly on your screen.
body:
⚔️ Combat Distance HUD

A lightweight, fully customizable Fabric client-side HUD mod for **Minecraft 1.21.9 – 1.21.11** that displays real-time combat distance information directly on your screen.

Track enemy distance, hit reach, incoming hits, and combat opponents with fully customizable text, colors, positions, and styling.

---

 ✨ Features

 🎯 Target Distance HUD

Displays the distance to the player you're currently looking at.

Examples:

```text
Distance: 3.42 blocks
🎯 3.42
Target → 3.42 Blocks Away
⚔ Steve | 3.42
```

 ⚔ Last Hit Distance HUD

Shows the exact distance when you successfully hit another player.

Examples:

```text
Last Hit: 3.12 blocks
⚔ Reach: 3.12
Hit Steve: 3.12b
```

 ☠ Hit-By Distance HUD

Shows the distance at which another player hit you.

Examples:

```text
Hit By: 2.98 blocks
☠ Enemy Reach: 2.98
Steve hit you: 2.98b
```

 👤 Opponent Tracker HUD

Tracks the most recent player you entered combat with and updates their distance in real time.

Examples:

```text
⚔ Steve | 4.32 blocks
Tracking: Steve - 4.32
🎯 Steve: 4.32 blocks
```

---

 🔥 Main Features

* 4 independent HUD modules
* Real-time distance updates
* Fully customizable text formatting
* Drag-and-drop HUD editor
* Per-module settings
* Global appearance settings
* Unicode symbol support
* Emoji support
* Mod Menu integration
* Multi-language support
* Zero server installation required
* Client-side only
* Extremely lightweight

---

 📝 Placeholder Support

Use placeholders anywhere in your HUD text.

| Placeholder  | Description    |
| ------------ | -------------- |
| `{distance}` | Distance value |
| `{player}`   | Player name    |
| `{unit}`     | Unit label     |

Example:

```text
⚔ {player}: {distance} {unit}
```

Output:

```text
⚔ Steve: 3.42 blocks
```

---

 🎨 Customization

Every module supports:

 Position

* X Offset
* Y Offset
* Anchor Selection
* Drag & Drop Placement

 Appearance

* Text Color
* Background Color
* Outline Color
* Shadow Color
* Opacity
* Padding
* Scale
* Font Scale

 Formatting

* Custom Text Templates
* Decimal Precision
* Unit Labels
* Visibility Options

---

 ⚙️ Commands

| Command                    | Description          |
| -------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `/combatdistance`          | Mod information      |
| `/combatdistance config`   | Open config screen   |
| `/combatdistance reload`   | Reload config        |
| `/combatdistance toggle`   | Enable / disable mod |
| `/combatdistance reset`    | Reset HUD positions  |
| `/combatdistance resetall` | Reset all settings   |

---

 📥 Installation

 Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.9–1.21.11
* Fabric Loader 0.17.2+
* Fabric API
* Java 21+

 Optional

* Mod Menu

 Installation Steps

1. Install Fabric Loader.
2. Install Fabric API.
3. Download Combat Distance HUD.
4. Place the mod inside your `mods` folder.
5. Launch Minecraft.

---

 📌 Supported Versions

| Version | Status |
| ------- | ------ |
| 1.21.9  | ✅      |
| 1.21.10 | ✅      |
| 1.21.11 | ✅      |

---

 ⚡ Performance

Designed to have virtually no FPS impact.

* CPU Usage: Negligible
* Memory Usage: < 2 MB
* Render Time: < 0.01ms/frame
* Safe for 500+ FPS clients

---

 🔧 Compatibility

Works on:

* Vanilla Servers
* Fabric Servers
* Paper Servers
* Spigot Servers
* PvP Servers
* Minigame Servers

No server-side installation required.

---

 ❓ FAQ

- Does this work on servers?

Yes. The mod is entirely client-side and works on virtually any server.

- Is this allowed?

The mod only displays information already available to your client. Always follow individual server rules regarding client modifications.

- Can I move HUD elements?

Yes. Use the built-in HUD editor or configure positions manually.

- Can I use custom symbols?

Yes. Unicode symbols and emojis are supported.

- Does it affect performance?

No measurable impact during normal gameplay.
